commands: if [ -d menutopic ]; then echo 'Backing up existing menutopic'; mv menutopic menutopic.bak.$TS; fi

if git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/davidherney/moodle-format_menutopic menutopic; then echo 'Git clone OK'; else echo 'Git clone failed; falling back to zip'; yum install -y unzip || true; curl -L -o /tmp/menutopic.zip https://github.com/davidherney/moodle-format_menutopic/archive/refs/heads/master.zip; mkdir -p menutopic; unzip -q /tmp/menutopic.zip -d /tmp; cp -a /tmp/moodle-format_menutopic-master/. menutopic/; fi
